BACKEND.title: Backend

FULLSTACK.title: Fullstack

QA.title: QA Engineering

MOBILE.title: Mobile

DATA_ML.title: Data Science / ML

JUNIOR.title: Junior

MIDDLE.title: Middle

SENIOR.title: Senior
SENIOR.desc: System architecture, advanced algorithms, trade-off analysis, and technical leadership

LEAD.title: Lead / Staff

enterprise.title: Enterprise & Corporations
